decision_rules.H1: SUPPORTED iff d_struct and exact OT are monotone non-increasing D25->D50->D75 in all 3 reps; MIXED if either is monotone in >=1 rep
decision_rules.H2: SUPPORTED iff every D arm retains frozen P90 tail >= B in all reps; MIXED iff at least one fixed D arm does so in all reps
decision_rules.H3: PRELIMINARILY_SUPPORTED iff one fixed D arm beats C Original70 3/3 and is not worse GAP5 3/3; MIXED iff any fixed arm beats C in 1-2 reps
decision_rules.H4: SUPPORTED_PRELIMINARY iff one fixed D arm beats B Original70 3/3 and is not worse GAP5 3/3; MIXED iff any arm beats B in 1-2 reps
decision_rules.H5: SUPPORTED_PRELIMINARY iff one fixed D arm beats M4 Original70 3/3; PARTIAL iff any does in 1-2 reps
decision_rules.H6: SUPPORTED_EXPLORATORY iff structure ratio has consistent monotone offline tradeoff and same-direction Original70 rank in all reps; MIXED if offline tradeoff holds but gap rank differs
decision_rules.H7: PROMISING only if H3 and H4 supported and H5 not NOT_SUPPORTED; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED unless all gain tests fail

quota: deterministic largest remainder; tie niche id
selection_order: STRUCTURE ascending score then HARDNESS descending frozen HGB; hash tie
structure_score: minimum frozen P6-A squared Top5 candidate-reference cost

training.formal_source: P6-B/P6-C2 core.train via audited P6-D1 adapter
